findings.title: Bind artifact approval to the exact qualified run and asset bytes before publication
findings.trigger: Supply a passing artifact/notes review from build run A while invoking publication for run B built from the same source SHA and same notes; A and B have different tar.gz/build-info digests.
findings.evidence: The review checks only status, source_sha and reviewed_notes_sha256. The subsequent artifact comparison binds current files to current host-qualification.json but never binds those bytes or that qualification receipt to the independent review. A stale same-source review therefore passes all current review predicates.
findings.impact: An earlier independent review can authorize publication of a different, unreviewed artifact/runtime run. This violates the exact reviewed artifact prerequisite even though source/tag identity is correct.
findings.requested_change: Before push-main, require review.run_directory to equal the resolved RUN, review.host_qualification_sha256 to match the exact current qualification receipt, and review.artifact_sha256 to equal the exact three current asset digests; retain current source/notes checks. Require the artifact reviewer to write those fields.
findings.validation: Pure in-memory evaluation of the current three review predicates accepted differing host and reviewed artifact digest maps. No helper execution or external action.
